title: Patch: Stinkyscape balance pass — Starship tag, Marketplace prices, Weapons and twenty cards
notes: The owner's balance pass #3000, built as a fullsend tree (#3038 to #3048) and reconciled by a Claude session: Starship becomes a tag with innate Flying and Ranged (R3038000), launches for (4), and the Drone Battleship's layers stop being Starships (R3038002); an awakened card is never Dormant again and a Flashback play keeps Flashback (R3039000, R3039001); every Weapon's Health halved and the Rush Token Launcher reaches a Locked zone (#3040); eight Stinkyscape cards (#3041), five more cards (#3042), True Craft a Card's points (#3043), Twinspell as an Activate (R3044000); a fused Miner or Weapon keeps its host's art and a Starship its name (R3045000), full art on the board (R3046000); the Marketplace's four offers, new prices, (0) buys and Buffed or Nerfed offers (R3047000 to R3047004); Echo's Coin fallback and Death by 1000 cuts' kept targets (R3048000 to R3048002). The AI scores a decision over a Starship by its hand evaluation (R3038003).

player.title: Stinkyscape balance pass
balance: Every Weapon has half its Health: the Rare ones are 0/2 (Radiant 0/4), the Epic ones 0/3 (0/6) and the Legendary ones 0/4 (0/8).
Launching a Starship costs (4), up from (3).
In a hurry costs (3), up from (2), and summons 4 Rush Tokens, up from 3.
MC Tech steals when your opponent controls 5 or more permanents, up from 4.
The Propagation's Hornet is 3/3 (Radiant 6/6), down from 3/4 (6/8).
Rod of Ages turns Radiant at 12 keywords, up from 10, and loses Quickdraw and Flying.
True Craft a Card crafts with about a fifth fewer points.
In Too Deep's quests each ask about a fifth more, and the last one before Indestructible asks clearly more.
Twinspell's Radiant face gives Echo +1, down from +2.
changes: Starship is now a tag, and every Starship, Dormant or launched, has Flying and Ranged.
The Drone Battleship's Shield, Propagation and Meltdown Layers are no longer Starships: they have Flying and Ranged, and Scornboi exiles them.
A card that awakens from Dormant is never Dormant again.
A card played by Flashback keeps Flashback, so it can be flashed back again.
The Marketplace offers 4 cards a turn: 8 Credits at (0), 15 at (1), then 10 more for each mana up to (4) and 15 more for each after that.
A card bought from the Marketplace costs (0), and some offers come Buffed, for more Credits, or Nerfed, for fewer.
A Resource card in your hand shows how many Credits it sells for this turn.
Twinspell is an Activate: the next Spell you play this turn gains Echo +1, then it goes to the graveyard. The Radiant one stays and works once a turn.
Echo has The Coin's text until a Spell has been played.
Death by 1000 cuts repeats by the mana you have left after paying for it, and every repeat hits the first target.
Drone Hanger summons its Drone Interceptor with an Activate instead of at the start of your turn.
ZolarKeth's second choice summons a random Starship Piece at the end of your turn instead of by an Activate.
Jlockeed's J15 Fighter has Can't Defend.
Jlockeed's Missile Pod rounds its damage up.
Asphyxiants Cloud has Flashback and deals 1 damage to all enemies (Radiant 2), and your next Spell this turn has Poisonous. It no longer draws.
Rush Token Launcher can summon its Rush Token into a Locked zone.
A Unit with a Miner or a Weapon fused into it keeps its own picture, and a Starship keeps its name as cards fuse into it.
Full-art cards look full-art on the board too, with their name below the picture.
